description: MND-specific guidance about swallowing change, eating and drinking safety, speech pathology and dietitian support.
eligibility: People living with MND, carers and care teams.
funding_notes: Assessment and nutrition support may involve MND clinics, speech pathology, dietetics, NDIS, aged care or local health services.
name: Eating, drinking and swallowing with MND

description: MND-specific guidance about weight loss, high-energy intake, nutrition strategies and feeding tube decisions.
eligibility: People living with MND, carers and treating clinicians.
funding_notes: Dietitian review, supplements and enteral feeding supports may require health service, NDIS, aged care or private funding pathways.
name: Maintaining weight for health with MND

description: International framework for texture-modified foods and thickened liquids, including levels, descriptors and testing methods.
eligibility: Use only as directed by speech pathology, dietetics or other qualified clinicians.
funding_notes: The framework itself is free; thickened fluids, supplements and modified meals may have separate funding or purchase pathways.
name: IDDSI food texture and drink thickness framework
